lamps.steady: Fault in airbag or seat belt pretensioner system. Have inspected by an authorised workshop as soon as possible.
Light comes on briefly when ignition is turned ON to check function.
lamps.flashing: Problem with key or immobilizer system; engine will not start. Switch to LOCK then ON; if blinking continues, contact workshop.

lamps.steady: Parking brake engaged, low brake fluid, or ABS proportioning valve failure. Stop safely, test brakes, or tow to workshop.
ABS malfunction. Stop safely, restart engine; if light stays on, have system inspected at an authorised workshop.
Insufficient oil pressure. Pull over, stop engine, check oil level, and inspect lubrication system before driving again.
Battery charging system malfunction. Have charging system inspected immediately by an authorised workshop.
Driver or front passenger seat belt is not fastened.
lamps.flashing: Driver or front passenger seat belt is unbuckled while driving. Fasten seat belts properly.

lamps.lamp: Rear passenger's seat belt reminder light
lamps.steady: Rear passengers have not fastened their seat belts. Fasten seat belts.
Emission control or Auto Gear Shift system problem. Have vehicle inspected at an authorised workshop.
lamps.flashing: Engine misfire detected that can damage catalytic converter. Stop immediately in a safe place and contact workshop.

lamps.steady: Auto Gear Shift system problem. Have system inspected at an authorised workshop.
lamps.flashing: Auto Gear Shift clutch temperature is too high. Stop vehicle in a safe place to cool down.

lamps.steady: Power steering system malfunction. Have system inspected by an authorised workshop.

lamps.lamp: High engine coolant temperature warning light
lamps.steady: Engine is overheating. Stop safely, idle engine to cool, check coolant level, and follow manual instructions.
lamps.flashing: Engine is running hot. Avoid driving conditions that lead to actual overheating.
Turn signals or hazard lights active. Rapid blinking indicates turn signal system malfunction.

lamps.steady: Headlight high beams are turned on.
Position lights, tail lights, or headlights are turned on.
Malfunction in ESP systems (other than ABS). Have system inspected by an authorised workshop.
lamps.flashing: Traction or stability control system is actively operating. Drive carefully.

lamps.steady: ESP traction and stability control systems are deactivated using ESP OFF switch.
